## Reader benefit

Describe the concrete problem and how this change helps a reader.

## Change type

- [ ] Tool-page fact correction and synchronized translations
- [ ] Improvement to one of the 13 bilingual tool practices
- [ ] New original community practice in `practices/COMM-NNN.md`
- [ ] Attributed X example or media-link correction
- [ ] Documentation or validator maintenance
- [ ] Reviewed correction to inherited source material with baseline explanation

## Evidence

- Exact tool or creator post URL:
- Check date and method:
- Status: page only / concept / tested
- For tested practice: settings, inputs, output link, edits and known defects:
- Authorship, rights and any relationship to the service:

## Checks

- [ ] New practice uses a COMM ID and is linked from the practice index; no new source-category recipe was inserted under `prompts/`.
- [ ] Changed tool facts match the manifest, profiles and all eight README tables.
- [ ] External creator credits and complete-prompt source links are preserved.
- [ ] Content checks and regression tests pass.
- [ ] The changelog explains the change, and no untested claim is presented as a measured result.
